info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Partner Reports/Templates API

params.name: service
params.description: List reports which use this service.

params.name: templateId
params.description: List reports with this report template ID.

params.name: from
params.description: List reports that were created on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.description: List reports that were created before this date.

params.name: regionId
params.description: Data in the report will be from organizations in this region, for example, US, CA, or EU.

params.name: onBehalfOfSubPartnerOrgId
params.description: The encoded organization ID for the sub partner.

items.docs:
Lists all reports previously generated from a given region. Use query parameters to filter the response. The parameters are optional.

To access this endpoint, you must use an administrator token with `spark-admin:reports_read` and `identity:people_read` scopes.

<div><Callout type="info">CSV reports for Webex suite services are only supported for organizations based in one region per API request. Organizations based in a different region will require a separate request with region specified.</C

params.name: onBehalfOfSubPartnerOrgId
params.description: The encoded organization ID for the sub partner.

items.docs:
Create a new report. A new report can be created using `templateId` available from the _List Report Templates_ API. For each `templateId`, there are a set of validation rules that need to be followed.

The `templateId` parameter is a number. However, it is a limitation of developer.webex.com platform that it is passed as a string when you try to test the API from here.

To access this endpoint, you must use an administrator token with `spark-admin:reports_write` and `identity:people_read` scopes

params.name: reportId
params.description: The unique identifier for the report.

params.name: onBehalfOfSubPartnerOrgId
params.description: The encoded organization ID for the sub partner.

items.docs:
Shows details for a report by report ID. Specify the report ID in the `reportId` parameter in the URI. To access this endpoint, you must use an administrator token with `spark-admin:reports_read` and `identity:people_read` scopes. **Notes**:
Reports are usually provided in zip format. A content-header application/zip or application/octet-stream does indicate the zip format. There is usually no .zip file extension.

Specify the report ID in the `reportId` parameter in the URI

To access this endpoint, you must use an administrator token with `spark-admin:reports_write` scope.

params.name: onBehalfOfSubPartnerOrgId
params.description: The encoded organization ID for the sub partner.

items.docs:
List report templates. Report templates are available for use with the Partner Reports API.

To access this endpoint, you must use an administrator token with `spark-admin:reports_read` and `identity:people_read` [scopes](/docs/integrations#scopes). The authenticated user must be a Partner full administrator or Partner read-only administrator of the organization.
